That's a rough run, and the failure rate you're describing isn't something I can wave off. I don't have the fleet numbers for how many Gammas and NerdQaxe++ units are still up, so I've put this in front of JD on our hardware side rather than guess. The team is offline now and picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email.

For the units failing now, the RMA intake is here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

The B30 is a different animal from a Bitaxe: 6 BM1373 chips, 400 to 450 W, built for 24/7. That's the one to judge us on.
I purchased miners from a few different vendors as availability was inconsistant

That makes sense, stock has been all over the place this year across the board.

If you ever want to sort which of your units came from us, your four orders with us are on file and I can check any serial or unit against them. And if one of the ones we sold you is among the dead, that's an RMA we'll take.
I will check. With 15 miners over the past year and half, Ill try and trackdown each units supplier

Fifteen units is a real fleet, that'll take some digging.

Come back with anything, a serial or just a model and rough date, and I'll tell you if it's ours. JD will also come back to you tomorrow on the failure pattern you described. Your B30 is still on for October 30.
Thansk
